text:
olivia: Heads-up: pipeline for release v2.3.1 is blocked during the staging promotion step. Deploybot is failing to acquire cache lease and e2e job 12 is flaky.

gabe: saw the alert — which job specifically? logs?

olivia: deploybot logs show `cache-lease: failed to acquire lease: timeout` right before image promote. Then e2e-12 times out intermittently.

ci-bot: [automated] build #2489 failed: staging-promotion step exited 1. last log lines:
```
2026-03-20T18:05:12Z ERROR deploybot: cache lease acquire timeout (attempts=3)
2026-03-20T18:05:13Z WARN e2e-12: flaky assertion timeout after 90s
Traceback (most recent call last): ... AssertionError: expected 200 got 504
```

sam: @maria-oncall are you able to check the deploybot host pool? might be network blips to the cache backend.

maria-oncall: looking. I can repro the cache lease timeouts on one executor in eu-west-1. investigating connectivity to redis-cache.

lina: if that node is misbehaving we should pin to last-good artifact and hold the canary. Don't want partial rollout.

gabe: agree. what's last-good image tag? if we pin we avoid rollback churn.

olivia: last-good is `redwood/v2.3.1-canary.20260318-1642`. We can pin for the change window (tomorrow 02:00 UTC) or hold now and re-run after fix.

sam: what about running e2e-12 in isolation against the pinned artifact to confirm it's not solely the cache flake? quick yes/no?

lina: do that. I'll create a short job to rerun just e2e-12 with `--skip-cache` on the staging runner.

deploybot: [automated] manual-promotion blocked: cache lease failure detected. Promotion deferred.

maria-oncall: redis node had intermittent auth failures — KMS rotation trace shows a rolling update at 18:03 that might have hit the node. Restarting redis on the executor now.

ci-bot: rerun requested: `./ci rerun --job e2e-12 --artifact redwood/v2.3.1-canary.20260318-1642 --no-cache`

olivia: thanks. if rerun passes we can either pin and push release window or unblock immediate promote. prefer to keep within today's change window? we have 2 hours left.

gabe: if e2e-12 passes and redis restarts look stable, i vote for immediate promote with pinned artifact to avoid more manual rollback later. add rollback plan in release notes.

sam: rollback plan: revert promote and redeploy `redwood/v2.3.1-canary.20260317-2310` (previous stable) + re-run smoke tests. keep ops oncall for 30m post-promote.

lina: noted. I'll add the pin and rollback steps to the promote checklist.

maria-oncall: redis looks healthy now, auth/rotation completed. no more lease timeouts on my side. Running the isolated e2e now.

ci-bot: e2e-12 run #5: PASS (duration 41s)

olivia: awesome. ok promoting pinned artifact now. @deploybot please proceed with manual promote to prod and apply the canary -> stable tag mapping.

deploybot: [automated] manual promote accepted by olivia. Starting promotion: staging -> prod. Will run smoke checks and hold on any alert. ETA ~6m.

sam: reminder: leave the monitoring slack thread open for 30m. if any error >=5% convert to rollback.

gabe: +1

deploybot: [automated] smoke checks: all green. promote complete. artifact tagged `v2.3.1` -> `stable`.

olivia: thanks everyone. I added a short blurb to release notes: "Promoted pinned canary due to transient cache lease failures; rollback plan prepared."

lina: follow-up: we should add a guard in deploybot to retry cache lease with backoff and to surface KMS rotation hints in alerts.

maria-oncall: filing infra ticket with traces and KMS rotation timeline: INFRA-4721.

sam: closing loop — will monitor metrics for next 2 hours. if anything weird I'll reopen this thread.

gabe: nice recovery. :thumbsup:
